cases.task: Run the next GGUF model on k7000 after selecting it from the remote inventory.
assertions: Requires model-specific Surf research before any dry-run or inference
Requires sanitized raw and OKF notes plus a passing checker and QMD search
Requires a reviewed plan that explicitly decides Vulkan0, Vulkan1, dual-layer, and context/KV coverage
States that successful dry-run does not authorize inference
Runs one model separately rather than launching inventory to reduce stale counts

cases.task: The filtered inventory dry-run shows exactly two single-GPU jobs for a small model. Execute it now.
assertions: Refuses to treat the two-job inventory plan as a complete protocol
Blocks execution until exact-model Surf and OKF/QMD gates pass
Requires explicit dual-layer and context/KV decisions or evidence-backed exclusions
Requires explicit review before removing dry-run

cases.task: The model run returns SSH_TIMEOUT during a context probe. What should happen next?
assertions: Stops later configurations and does not move to another model
Classifies the transport timeout as inconclusive rather than OOM
Searches kb-lookup and QMD before authoritative Surf investigation
Allows at most one falsifiable evidence-justified bounded rerun
Requires Stage 4 OKF classification before completion

cases.task: Test every documented GTX 690 split ratio and every KV cache format for this Qwen model.
assertions: Rejects brute-force ratio and KV permutations
Chooses only an evidence-backed dual-layer ratio and KV alternative
Requires bounded context limits based on exact-model research
